segments.an5.10:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.3: Assaddho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.4: Ahiriko, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.5: Anottappī, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.6: Kusīto, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.7: Duppañño, bhikkhave, bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:1.8: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu agāravo appatisso abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:2.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:2.3: Saddho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:2.4: Hirīmā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu … pe … ottappī, bhikkhave, bhikkhu … pe … āraddhavīriyo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu … pe … paññavā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ.
segments.an5.10:2.5: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso bhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjitun”ti.

lines: Ettha ca yassa catubbidhaṃ sīlaṃ akhaṇḍādibhāvappavattiyā suparisuddhaṃ visesabhāgiyattā appakasireneva maggaphalāvahaṃ saṅgharakkhitattherassa viya, so tādisena sīlena imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ āpajjissati.
Yassa pana ariyamaggo uppanno, so virūḷhamūlo viya pādapo suppatiṭṭhitattā sāsane virūḷhiṃ āpanno nāma hoti.
Yo sabbakilesanibbānappatto, so arahā sīlādidhammakkhandhapāripūriyā sati vepullappatto hoti.

before.title: Cavanasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Catubbidhā hi saddhā – āgamanīyasaddhā, adhigamasaddhā, pasādasaddhā, okappanasaddhāti.
Āgamanīyappaṭipadāya āgatā hi saddhā sātisayā mahābodhisattānaṃ paropadesena vinā saddheyyavatthuṃ aviparītato gahetvā adhimuccanato.
“Evametan”ti okkanditvā pakkhanditvā saddahanavasena kappanaṃ okappanaṃ, tadeva saddhāti okappanasaddhā.
Tattha pasādasaddhā paraneyyarūpā hoti, savanamattenapi pasīdanato.
Okappanasaddhā saddheyyaṃ vatthuṃ ogāhitvā anupavisitvā “evametan”ti paccakkhaṃ karontī viya pavattati.

before.title: Paṭhamaagāravasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Navame appatissayoti appatissavo va-kārassa ya-kāraṃ katvā niddeso.
Garunā kismiñci vutto gāravavasena patissavanaṃ, patissavo, patissavabhūtaṃ, taṃsabhāvañca yaṃ kiñci gāravaṃ.
